text: Long rest intervals provide a sustained ability to maintain mechanical tension throughout each successive set. Strength capacity has been shown to be largely preserved over 3 sets with rest intervals of 3 minutes or more (123, 189). However, metabolite accumulation diminishes with increasing rest between sets, particularly with respect to lactic acid buildup (1).
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 4: Role of Resistance Training Variables in Hypertrophy
